messages:
Anna K: heads up — rolling cutover for v2.1.3 starts in ~10m in the US-EAST change window. Release notes pushed: https://internal.redwood/releases/2.1.3 :eyes: Please watch svc-gateway + embed-service SLO dashboards. I'll pin the notes and canary targets.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: v2.1.3 -> canary (10%). CI: ✅ all checks passed. Canary ID: canary-2026-03-21-17. Command: `rwdctl deploy --service svc-gateway --image rwd/svc-gateway:v2.1.3 --target canary=10%`

Mike L: quick q — rollback policy? automatic on 5xx spike or manual?

Anna K: rollback = automatic if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 > threshold in svc-gateway. Manual otherwise. See rollout config I just linked in the release notes.

Jess R: FYI we reduced inference batch size default from 16 -> 8 in this build (smaller bursts). Expect a small p95 uplift for short sequences. Watch token-latency and request-latency charts.

Tim S: I'll add temporary 5% route-sampling for embed endpoints and kick off the smoke runner. Running: `k6 run smoke.js --vus 5 --duration 2m`

sre-monitor: ALERT (automated): svc-gateway p95 +12% vs baseline over last 2m. Metric: svc-gateway.latency.p95 = 520ms (baseline 465ms).

Anna K: seeing it. Holding canary at 10% and scaling canary pool +1 GPU to absorb load. Do not ramp beyond 10% until we confirm. :pause_button:

Mike L: I'll update rollout to keep automatic rollback threshold stricter for this cutover (5xx -> 0.6% for 3m). Pushing change to deploy config now.

Jess R: starting synthetic smoke against canary: `curl -sS http://canary.svc-gateway.internal/health` -> OK

Output:
```
{
  "status": "ok",
  "uptime": "2m",
  "version": "v2.1.3-canary"
}
```

sre-monitor: SLO check (automatic): error-rate steady, p95 trending down. p95 now 468ms.

Anna K: good — p95 back near baseline. Moving to 50% in 10m if no regressions. I'll note the temporary config changes in the release notes and log the decision. :white_check_mark:

Tim S: leaving the 5% route-sample in place for another 15m and monitoring traces.

Mike L: added a short rollback note to the release: fallback to v2.1.2 for model-serving if 5xx > 0.6% for 3m.

Jess R: k6 smoke finished — no obvious errors, throughput nominal.

sre-monitor: NOTICE: canary metrics stabilized; no active alerts from svc-gateway or embed-service.

Anna K: ok proceeding to 50% in 10m. I'll post again when we hit 100% or if anything pops. Thanks all. :rocket:
